Hi Alex / Brittany — great to hear Stadium found the demo helpful. Attached is a concise proposal and a short SLA excerpt you can share with procurement. High level: 

- Uptime tiers (monthly average):
  • Standard (99.5%) — included with Dedicated; credits scale: 5% invoice credit for each 0.1% below SLA (capped)
  • Assured (99.9%) — +20% on base commit; 10% invoice credit slab for breaches
  • Enterprise (99.95%) — +40% on base commit; 15% invoice credit slab + priority routing and regional standby

- On-call retainer options (two choices):
  1) Retainer + hourly surge: $12k/mo retainer (covers up to 10 hours/month), $250/hr beyond; includes phone escalation and playbook review.
  2) Credit-bundled: pre-purchased 200 on-call credits/mo (each credit = 15 min triage) that draw down against incidents; recommended for frequent bursts.

- For your use case I recommend Enterprise (99.95%) with the retainer + hourly for predictable cross-region failover coverage.

Attached: redwood_premium_terms_v2.pdf — contains a sample SOW excerpt and the SLA response windows. I also included language for escalation obligations and RTO targets.
